items.name: Event
items.summary: `Event`s represent single points in time where something occurred during the execution of a program.

methods.name: child_of
methods.signature: fn child_of(parent: impl Into<Option<Id>>, metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>, fields: &'a field::ValueSet<'_>)
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Event` with the specified metadata and set of values, and observes it with the current subscriber and an explicit parent.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Event` with the specified metadata and set of values, and observes it with the current subscriber.

methods.name: fields
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the set of values on this `Event`.

methods.name: is_contextual
methods.summary: Returns true if the new event's parent should be determined based on the current context.

methods.name: is_root
methods.summary: Returns true if the new event should be a root.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>, fields: &'a field::ValueSet<'a>) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a new `Event` in the current span, with the specified metadata and set of values.

methods.name: new_child_of
methods.signature: fn new_child_of(parent: impl Into<Option<Id>>, metadata: &'static Metadata<'static>, fields: &'a field::ValueSet<'a>) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a new `Event` as a child of the specified span, with the provided metadata and set of values.

methods.name: parent
methods.summary: Returns the new event's explicitly-specified parent, if there is one.

methods.name: record
methods.summary: Visits all the fields on this `Event` with the specified [visitor].
